This résumé renders from a single structured-data file; the platform serving it is the portfolio.

projects.name: cohns.net — a platform that is its own portfolio
projects.summary: A public Terraform/Ansible monorepo that builds and runs cohns.net end to end — an AWS Organization, a containerized API, content pipelines, and observability — with no long-lived credentials anywhere.
highlights: AWS Organization with isolated dev/stage/prod accounts, SCP guardrails, and IAM Identity Center — zero access keys: humans authenticate with SSO, CI with GitHub OIDC.
Terraform module library on a dev → stage → prod promotion model; keyless CI runs fmt/validate/plan with environment-gated applies.
Containerized FastAPI service on ECS Fargate over Aurora Serverless v2 that scales to zero — $0 at idle.
Observability as code: Grafana Cloud synthetics + CloudWatch read through an assumed role (no vendor key), dashboards, alarms, and a per-account cost budget — all on the free tier.
Security-gated pipelines: tflint + checkov on every change with SARIF to the Security tab, plus Dependabot for the supply chain.
